intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: premise hook at pace, three quick options, a 3-s ticking beat, a dry reveal, three consequence beats each with a place and a number, punchline + four-word follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.direction: a claim with a number, fast, then the question
lines.text: A range called the Alps… nowhere near Europe. Five hundred kilometres of peaks. Which country?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: It's New Zealand: the Southern Alps run about five hundred kilometres down the South Island.
Highest: Aoraki, Mount Cook, three thousand seven hundred and twenty-four metres, taller than anything in Australia.
The Tasman Glacier, its longest, runs twenty-three kilometres into a lake that did not exist in 1970.
It all rides the Alpine Fault, where the Pacific and Australian plates collide and lift the range every year.

lines.direction: punchline, then four words — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Still rising. Follow for tomorrow's map.

title: In which country are the SOUTHERN ALPS?
